description: A/B route set that removes project-specific nouns and domain-heavy wording so the zero-shot router must focus more on user intent than subject similarity.

routes.route: Request to explain a fact, concept, definition or how something works
Request for casual conversation, a social reply, a joke, encouragement or an opinion
Request to change, enable, disable, start, stop or configure something
Request to know the present state, setting, configuration or connection state of something
Request for information that depends on what is true or available now
Request to recall information from an earlier interaction
Request to inspect or identify what is currently visible in an image or live view
Request to read or report a current measurement, reading or signal
Request to calculate a result or convert a quantity
Request for current or forecast atmospheric conditions
Request for a market price, financial quote or currency exchange rate
Request to diagnose the cause of a problem or find a fix
